summary: Ameriguard Security Services, Inc. filed an 8-K to report the issuance of 8,756,150 common shares to Lillian Flores in partial conversion of $2,456,991 of outstanding debt. The transaction was conducted under exemptions from registration under Section 4(a)(2) and/or Rule 506 of Regulation D; no underwriter or placement agent is named. This is a routine debt-for-equity conversion, not a transformative special situation. The filing lacks a tender, acquisition, restructuring, or activist campaign. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or strategic review. The structure is a simple private placement to settle debt, with no price per share, premium, or close date specified. No further watch items or risk-arb angle are applicable.
